properties.value: Generated by scripts/gen-vinland.ts. Authored at 2x texture px (64px tiles = 32 logical).

properties.name: text
properties.value: Welcome to Vinland. Walk with WASD or click to move, hold Shift to run. Press E at a ✦ to look closer.

properties.name: text
properties.value: Smoke curls from the roof hole and there is a smell of barley stew. The hall is warm, and the benches are being laid out for the evening meal.

properties.name: text
properties.value: The water is cold and clean. A wooden bucket knocks against the stone.

properties.name: text
properties.value: The lake is still today. Good water for fishing, and a boat ready if you want it.

properties.name: text
properties.value: Runes are cut deep into the grey stone, worn soft by weather. Nobody living remembers who raised it, or for whom.

properties.name: text
properties.value: The fire has been kept alive. Someone will come back for it. Sit a while — this is where people will gather once there are others here.

properties.name: text
properties.value: Wild grapes, heavy on the trellis. This is the land they named for them.

properties.name: text
properties.value: Meltwater off the northern ridge, loud and cold. The spray reaches you from here.
